SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parcel p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND DATE(p.in_time) = CURDATE() AND p.station_id = #{stationId}) AS todayInCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pickup_record r WHERE DATE(r.pickup_time) = CURDATE() AND r.station_id = #{stationId}) AS todayPickupCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ship_order s WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND DATE(s.create_time) = CURDATE() AND s.station_id = #{stationId}) AS todayShipCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parcel p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 'IN_STORE' AND p.station_id = #{stationId}) AS inStoreCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parcel p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 'IN_STORE' AND p.in_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL p.overdue_days DAY) AND p.station_id = #{stationId}) AS overdueCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exception_record e WHERE e.handle_status IN ('PENDING', 'HANDLING') AND e.station_id = #{stationId}) AS exceptionCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parcel p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 'DELIVERING' AND p.station_id = #{stationId}) AS deliveringCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parcel p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.station_id = #{stationId}) AS totalParcelCount,
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(sh.capacity), 0) FROM shelf sh WHERE sh.status = 1 AND sh.station_id = #{stationId}) AS shelfTotal,
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(sh.used_count), 0) FROM shelf sh WHERE sh.status = 1 AND sh.station_id = #{stationId}) AS shelfUsed

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(p.in_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS d, COUNT(*) AS c FROM parcel p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.in_time >= #{startDate} AND p.in_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND p.station_id = #{stationId} GROUP BY d ORDER BY d

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r.pickup_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS d, COUNT(*) AS c FROM pickup_record r WHERE r.pickup_time >= #{startDate} AND r.pickup_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND r.station_id = #{stationId} GROUP BY d ORDER BY d
SELECT p.express_company AS `name`, COUNT(*) AS `value` FROM parcel p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.station_id = #{stationId} GROUP BY p.express_company ORDER BY `value` DESC
SELECT p.parcel_type AS `name`, COUNT(*) AS `value` FROM parcel p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.station_id = #{stationId} GROUP BY p.parcel_type ORDER BY `value` DESC

SELECT s.station_name AS stationName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parcel p WHERE p.station_id = s.id AND p.deleted = 0) AS parcelCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pickup_record r WHERE r.station_id = s.id) AS pickupCount FROM station s WHERE s.status = 1 ORDER BY parcelCount DESC
